The Vehicle Inspector role provides vehicle inspections for customers. Vehicle Inspectors will work in an online environment to provide vehicle inspections via video chat. Having live interaction with

ride share drivers, those with good customer service skills, ability to multitask and can

learn quickly will excel in the Vehicle Inspector role.

AREAS OF FOCUS

● Customer Service

● Vehicle Inspections

● Internal communication


RESPONSIBILITIES:


- Initiate video calls with drivers at their scheduled appointment time.

- Camera must remain on during all inspections with the company background

applied. Maintain a professional appearance; casual but neat attire is required.

- Explain the inspection process clearly and concisely.

- Answer basic questions related to the inspection or redirect to the appropriate team

when necessary.

- Verify the driver’s identity and confirm their inspection request.

- Guide the driver step-by-step in positioning their phone or camera to show the

necessary parts of the vehicle.

- Exterior and interior of the vehicle (including tires, lights, mirrors, seat belts, horn,

and other key points)

- Observe and assess the condition of each required inspection point to determine

whether the vehicle meets compliance standards.

- Communicate the pass/fail result to the driver and provide a brief explanation if the

vehicle fails.

- Record the inspection outcome (Pass, Fail, or No-Show) in the internal system

immediately after the appointment.


You are our perfect candidate if you are:


●A good communicator, excelent English speaking and writing;

●C1 level of Spanish language

●C1 level of English language

● Rideshare inspection knowledge a plus

● Able to multitask with attention to detail

● Customer service experience

● Good with technology

● Able to work alongside team members in an online environment

● Inspectors must have their own computer, smartphone and strong wifi service

●Are client-oriented and attentive to details, have active listening skills, problem solver, hard-

working, team-player.

●Self-employment. We will sign a contract with you as with independent businessman;

●You can work from home, don’t be distracted;


Mindy Support is a global company. We empower businesses all over the world through providing remote assistants and outsourced teams specialized in customer support, tech support, back office activities, and agile sales and marketing support.


We respect the individuality and culture of each member of our large team, and appreciate the contribution of each employee to support our Customers.


We will be glad to welcome you to our team. Grow your career with Mindy Support!

title: Fullstack AI Engineer
description:
Fullstack AI Engineer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

As a Fullstack AI Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle of a high-impact Generative AI MVP, translating complex architectural requirements into technical solutions. You will be responsible for building the bridge between Azure AI Foundry agents and the end-user, developing robust APIs, integrating RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, and implementing a simplified frontend. Beyond technical execution, you will collaborate closely with an AI Specialist and stakeholders to ensure the delivery of an explainable and compliant solution within an Agile framework.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Digest requirements from the architecture and product team to specify the implementation of new features from a fullstack and AI-integration perspective;
  • Implement the designed solution from coding to testing, focusing on Azure Functions, API development, and agentic workflows;
  • Follow Agile processes and participate actively in all development phases to ensure a functional MVP within 3 months;
  • Development of new features, including data connectors for Excel/Word and tool orchestration for LLM agents;
  • Design and maintain the application's frontend to provide a seamless interface for \"Well Engineers\";
  • Participate in the complete cycle of development from requirements gathering, RAG data ingestion, to final deployment;
  • Participate in technical discussions, demonstrations, and reviews with customers (Halliburton/Petrobras context).

Essential Skills

  • Solid Experience with Python (preferred) or Node.js;
  • Frameworks: ReactJS for frontend development;
  • AI Integration: Experience with LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or similar LLM orchestration frameworks;
  • Cloud Knowledge: Solid experience with Azure (Functions, App Service, and Blob Storage);
  • API Development: Experience with REST APIs and integrating third-party AI services;
  • Data Handling: Experience processing structured and unstructured data (Excel/Word) for AI consumption;
  • Solid experience with Git.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Azure AI Foundry and Azure AI Search;
  • Knowledge of Vector Databases and RAG architectures;
  • Experience with automated testing (Unit, Integration) for AI-driven applications;
  • Familiarity with AI Observability tools (Tracing, Prompt Logging);
  • Experience with Tailwind CSS or fast prototyping UI libraries;
  • Knowledge of Docker and CI/CD pipelines within Azure DevOps.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Video Editor - Ecom Specific
description:
E-commerce Video Editor, DTC Supplement Brand


About Us We're a fast-moving DTC supplement company running multiple 7-figure brands. Performance creative is our core driver. We ship ads daily on Meta and TikTok, and we need an editor who can keep pace with our output and edit in our voice.


The Role You'll edit 1 to 3 videos per day that will go into our meta ads pipeline. These are direct-response ads: UGC, AI-driven concepts, talking object skits, and native-style edits. You'll be in Discord daily, working closely with our creative strategist, video team, and brand owner.


What You'll Do

  • Edit 1 to 3 short-form video ads per day (15s to 60s) for Meta
  • Pull selects from raw UGC footage, B-roll, and AI-generated assets
  • Add captions, text overlays, music, SFX, and sound design that match e-commerce pacing
  • Iterate quickly on revisions via Frame.io
  • Manage your tasks and deliverables in ClickUp
  • Communicate progress, questions, and blockers daily in Discord

Required

  • 2+ years editing for DTC e-commerce brands (portfolio required)
  • Strong grasp of paid social pacing: fast cuts, hook density, retention engineering
  • Fluent in CapCut and/or Premiere Pro / DaVinci Resolve
  • Comfortable with Frame.io for upload and revisions
  • Comfortable with ClickUp (or able to ramp fast)
  • Available for daily Discord check-ins
  • Native or near-native English for caption accuracy

Big Plus

  • Experience with AI video tools (Sora, Veo, Runway, Kling, Pika, etc.)
  • Talking object / animated object editing
  • Polished AI voiceover work with clean text-on-screen synced tightly to AI VO
  • Strong sound design instincts (most ads die from bad audio)
  • Background editing for supplement, health, or wellness brands
  • Experience with raw listicle or native PDP style ads

  • Familiarity with AI Agents and text to flow/code automation.
  • Strong business analysis and workflow design skills.


What can you expect from us?

  • Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.
  • Opportunities to work outside Brazil
  • A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

  • Health Plan

title: Banco de Talentos GFT - Desenvolvimento .NET
description:
Banco de Talentos | Desenvolvimento .NET

Estamos construindo um banco de talentos com foco em profissionais de Desenvolvimento .NET, em diferentes níveis de senioridade (Júnior, Pleno, Sênior e Especialista/Tech Lead), que desejam atuar em projetos desafiadores, ambientes de alta performance e contextos tecnológicos inovadores.


Se você busca oportunidades para evoluir sua carreira e trabalhar com tecnologias modernas, queremos te conhecer!


O que você poderá fazer por aqui

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações utilizando a plataforma .NET;
  • Participar da construção de soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta performance;
  • Desenvolver APIs e microsserviços;
  • Trabalhar com arquitetura de sistemas e boas práticas de engenharia de software;
  • Integrar sistemas, mensageria e serviços em cloud;
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares em ambientes ágeis;
  • Contribuir com revisões de código e melhoria contínua da qualidade das entregas.


O que buscamos

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em .NET (C#, .NET Core / .NET 5+ ou superiores);
  • Conhecimento em construção de APIs RESTful;
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura de microsserviços e boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Experiência em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP), certificações (desejáveis);
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e/ou NoSQL;
  • Vivência com mensageria (como Kafka, RabbitMQ, entre outros) é um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em princípios SOLID e design patterns;
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git);
  • Interesse em qualidade de código, testes e boas práticas de engenharia.


Perfil que valorizamos

  • Colaboração e trabalho em equipe;
  • Proatividade e vontade de aprender continuamente;
  • Capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas;
  • Autonomia e organização na gestão do próprio trabalho;
  • Interesse por inovação e desafios tecnológicos.


Se identificou? Cadastre-se no nosso banco de talentos e fique por dentro das oportunidades que podem surgir

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
Senior Fullstack Developer — bTd Travel & Jets

BTD Business Traveler Deals Brazil Ltda · 100% Remote Contractor · Full-Time  April 2026


Who We Are

bTd Travel & Jets is a high-luxury corporate concierge platform that redefines how enterprises manage premium travel. We unify private jet bookings, helicopter transfers, and first-class commercial flights into a single, seamless experience — and we're building the AI layer that makes it all feel effortless.

Our mission is simple: let travelers focus on their business (or their vacation) while we handle every detail with precision and elegance. We serve enterprise clients who expect nothing less than perfection, and our technology needs to match that standard.


The Role

We're looking for a Senior Fullstack Developer  who thrives at the intersection of robust platform engineering and cutting-edge AI. You'll own end-to-end features — from a polished React UI to a Supabase edge function to a live AI agent pipeline — and you'll play a central role in building bTd Bella , our AI concierge agent powered by AWS Bedrock.

This is a hands-on engineering role . You will build, ship, and iterate in production — not just advise. If you've deployed AI agents that real users depend on and you love owning hard problems from architecture to release, we want to hear from you.


What You'll Do
  • Migrate production infrastructure  — move our environment from Replit to a dedicated, secure, and scalable VPS, building the foundation for the next phase of growth.
  • Architect and ship bTd Bella  — own the full lifecycle of our AWS Bedrock managed agent: setup, tool integration, knowledge base, guardrails, prompt tuning, and observability.
  • Build AI-powered platform features  — intelligent travel search, natural language booking flows, automated approval workflows, and proactive traveler notifications.
  • Expand travel and payment integrations  — POS providers, GDS/NDC APIs, Stripe, and Expedia Pay.
  • Raise the bar on code quality and architecture  — consolidate the codebase, enforce security standards, and mentor the team on AI and fullstack best practices.


✦ bTd Bella — AI Concierge Agent · AWS Bedrock

Bella is the heart of our AI strategy. She is a fully managed, multi-step conversational agent that assists corporate travelers with everything — finding flights, booking private jets, managing itineraries, routing approvals, and sending proactive alerts — all within a secure, policy-aware enterprise environment.

Your mission with Bella:  configure, deploy, and continuously improve a production-grade managed agent on AWS Bedrock. You'll define her tools, shape her reasoning, connect her to live data sources, and keep her accurate, safe, and cost-efficient at scale.


What you'll build for Bella
  • Managed Agent Setup  — Configure and deploy Bella as a fully managed agent on AWS Bedrock Agents: define action groups, instruction sets, session memory, and tool-calling behavior from end to end.
  • Tool & API Integration  — Connect Bella to flight search APIs, booking systems, approval workflows, and billing via Lambda-backed action groups with clean OpenAPI schemas.
  • Knowledge & RAG Pipeline  — Build and maintain the retrieval pipeline powering Bella's knowledge: travel policies, vendor catalogs, and traveler preferences via Bedrock Knowledge Bases.
  • Guardrails & Safety  — Implement Bedrock Guardrails to keep Bella on-topic, PII-safe, and hallucination-resistant in every interaction.
  • Prompt Engineering  — Write and iterate on Bella's system prompts, persona, and reasoning instructions so her responses feel accurate, human, and on-brand for luxury travel.
  • Evaluation & Reliability  — Build evaluation pipelines to track tool-selection accuracy, response quality, and latency — and act on the results continuously.

    • Tech Stack
    • Frontend:  React 18, TypeScript, Vite, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui
    • Backend:  Deno/TypeScript Edge Functions via Supabase
    • Database:  PostgreSQL with RLS, pgvector
    • Infrastructure:  Linux VPS, NGINX, Docker, SSL/Let's Encrypt
    • CI/CD:  GitHub Actions
    • Payments:  Stripe, Expedia Pay
    • AI & Agents:  AWS Bedrock (Claude 3, Amazon Nova, Titan Embeddings), Bedrock Agents, Bedrock Knowledge Bases, LangChain

    • What We're Looking ForFullstack Engineering
    • 5+ years building production applications with TypeScript across the full stack (React + Node.js/Deno).
    • Deep React 18 expertise: TanStack Query, react-hook-form, TailwindCSS, and scalable component architecture.
    • Solid Supabase experience — Auth, Edge Functions, RLS policies, and safe migrations.
    • Advanced PostgreSQL: complex queries, indexing strategies, transactions, and window functions.
    • DevOps fluency: Linux VPS administration, NGINX, Docker, systemd, and CI/CD via GitHub Actions.
    • Payment integration experience, preferably Stripe — idempotency, webhook verification, and signature handling.
    • Third-party API integrations including POS systems, GDS/NDC travel platforms, and async webhook handling with retry logic.
    • Security-first mindset: least privilege, secret management, and OWASP Top 10 compliance.
    AI, Agents — Hands-On RequiredWe need real, production experience — not theory. If you've set up a managed agent on AWS Bedrock, connected it to live tools, and made it work reliably under load, that's exactly what we're hiring for.
    • Hands-on experience setting up fully managed agents on AWS Bedrock Agents or similar  — action group definition, instruction tuning, session memory configuration, and multi-step tool-calling orchestration.
    • Experience building Lambda-backed action groups with OpenAPI schema authoring, error handling, and idempotency.
    • Practical knowledge of Bedrock Knowledge Bases: S3 data ingestion, chunking strategies, Titan Embeddings, and semantic retrieval tuning.
    • Strong prompt engineering skills: system prompt design, few-shot examples, chain-of-thought reasoning, structured output enforcement, and persona calibration.
    • Experience with Amazon Bedrock Guardrails: content filtering, PII redaction, topic denial policies, and grounding checks.
    • Ability to design and implement human-in-the-loop (HITL) flows — approval steps, escalation paths, and agent override mechanisms.
    • AWS IAM design for Bedrock workloads: service roles, Lambda execution roles, and least-privilege cross-service access patterns.
    • LLM cost management: token budget strategies, model tier selection, caching, and per-tenant consumption monitoring.
    • AI observability experience: tracing agent steps, logging LLM inputs/outputs, and evaluating response quality with CloudWatch, LangSmith, or equivalent.
    Differentiators
    • Experience in the travel industry — GDS, NDC, Amadeus, Sabre, or Expedia.
    • AWS certification (Solutions Architect, Developer, or ML Specialty).
    • Familiarity with multi-agent patterns: supervisor/worker agents, parallel tool execution, and EventBridge-triggered workflows.
    • AWS Step Functions for orchestrating long-running agentic workflows with human approval gates.
    • Background in multi-tenant SaaS architecture.
    • Comfortable with AI productivity tools — Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor.
    • Technical English for communication with international partners.
    What We Offer
    • 100% remote  with flexible hours — work where and when you do your best work.
    • Real autonomy  — your architectural decisions ship and your engineering impact is visible every day.
    • A technically ambitious project at the intersection of luxury travel and cutting-edge AI.
    • Modern, well-defined stack with no legacy baggage — we move fast and build things right.
    • Full-time contract with competitive compensation  matched to your seniority level.

title: Physical Therapist
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Physical Therapist to join our team.

If you have a passion for improving lives through exercise, certifications in sports medicine or orthopedic expertise, we want to hear from you. Our ideal candidate has a minimum of 3 years of experience, along with additional certifications, and is proficient in advanced English.


What We Offer:

  • Opportunity for career advancement and professional growth.
  • Full-time position with the flexibility to work from a home office.
  • Engaging work environment with deep human interaction, focused on patient care.
  • Chance to make a significant impact on patients' health and well-being.


Salary:

  • After a paid initial 4 month intensive education and on-boarding process which is paid at 1st month 1st month: R$3,100, 2nd month: R$4,650, 3rd month: R$6,200, 4th month: R$7,750. After one year, there will be an opportunity to increase your income beyond R$7,750 with most team members eventually earning over R$9,300,  per month.
  • After your first year with us you will have additional benefits of 2 weeks paid vacation, health insurance, and retirement funds.


Qualifications:

  • Minimum 3 years of experience.
  • Advanced English proficiency for clear communication.
  • Ability to effectively convey exercise techniques.
  • Sports medicine or Orthopedic expertise to address specific needs and limitations.
  • Additional certifications showcasing your commitment to professional growth.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Outgoing personality to motivate and engage patients.
  • Continuous training mindset to stay updated with industry advancements.
  • Strong organizational skills to manage patient progress and programs.


Responsibilities:


  • Design and provide feedback on personalized exercise programs for patients.
  • Utilize your teaching background to educate and empower patients.
  • Leverage orthopedic expertise to design safe and effective exercise routines.
  • Provide ongoing guidance and support for patients' fitness journeys.
  • Maintain open and effective communication with patients.

Join our team and be part of a dynamic environment where continuous training and deep human interaction are valued.

Employment Type

Full-time

title: Senior Golang Engineer
description:
Please note that the project operates in the UK time zone.


We are seeking a dedicated, motivated, and reliable Senior Golang Engineer who is interested in providing innovative software solutions for our clients. Be a part of our team as we continue to deliver high quality products and services. The Senior Go Engineer will be responsible for building backend services in Go in EKS, as well as some Lambdas. The overall project will be centered around providing product data and managing the product life cycle. If you are an open communicator with a passion for learning, love to think outside the box and you are excited about software development, we are looking for you!


RESPONSIBILITIES

• Use your deep expertise in Go and related technologies to develop high-quality, scalable, maintainable software solutions.

• Make technically sound decisions and champion high standards of coding and architecture best practices.

• Develop and maintain software documentation such as technical specifications and design documents.

• Continually enhance the team’s performance by mentoring, code reviews, and improving current processes in the SDLC.

• Troubleshoot and debug software issues as they arise.

• Collaborate within a cross functional team and be able to transform both functional and non-functional requirements into actionable work.

• Manage communication of progress/status to stakeholders.


WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• At least 4 years of professional software development experience.

• Proficiency in Go (Golang), including syntax, semantics, database connectivity, and object-oriented concepts.

• Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms.

• Experience working with Go frameworks such as Gin, Revel, Echo, Beego, etc.

• Strong understanding of web services (HTTP, SOAP, REST, GQL, etc.).

• Terraform, Lambdas, Writing API’s.

• Strong working knowledge of relational databases.

• Experience in troubleshooting issues and root cause analysis.

• A proven track record of delivering high quality and tested software on-time and often.

• An open mind, and the patience to explain issues in a constructive manner.

• Strong communication skills, with at least an intermediate level of English.

• Experience working in distributed, cross functional teams.


NICE TO HAVE

• Kubernetes or EKS.

• Algolia.

• Shopify.

• DynamoDB


Who We Are?

We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.


What's In It For You

  • We offer 100% remote work
  • Wellness/Fitness package
  • Paid trainings and certifications
  • 22 days of paid leave (27 days in the second year with us)
  • Professional Conferences and Training
  • Global Team Building Activities
  • Access to co-working spaces worldwide


Your applications and referrals are welcome!

  • Conhecimento básico de inglês
  • Possuir um dispositivo Android/iPhone
  • Concluir um treinamento online para aprender a trabalhar com o aplicativo móvel
  • Não é necessário ter formação em jornalismo

Oferecemos:

  • Trabalho perfeito para estudantes ou para complementar a renda
  • Treinamento completo e gratuito
  • 62 euros (aproximadamente 405 reais) por partida coberta, além de reembolso de despesas de viagem e ingressos


Estados onde precisamos urgentemente de pessoas para coleta de dados nos locais dos jogos:

  • Maranhão
  • Mato Grosso/Mato Grosso do Sul

title: Senior Software Engineer - C#
description:
About the Company

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer, based of Argentina or Brazil, with a strong specialization in C#, software development methodologies and the ability to design, develop and maintain complex .NET / C# based applications, while also contributing significantly to the technical excellence of the team.


Responsibilities

  • Exceptional problem solving skills to identify and solve complex technical issues efficiently.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to integrate frontend and backend components seamlessly.
  • Communicates effectively with team members, stakeholders and non-technical persons and also collaborates well within a team, sharing knowledge and mentoring junior developers.
  • Help maintain code quality, organization, and automation.
  • Shows a strong commitment to learning and staying up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.
  • Develop strategies for transitioning from legacy systems to modern architectures.
  • Participate in Agile development processes, including sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.


Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience as backend developer with a strong focus on C#.
  • Proficient in .NET Framework/.NET Core.
  • Can design RESTful APIs, architect software systems (taking into consideration scalability, maintainability and performance).
  • Emphasizes the importance of testing, automated testing frameworks and writing unit tests.
  • Strong knowledge of database systems (SQL, NoSQL).
  • Familiar with design patterns, microservices, event driven architecture and other software design principles.
  • Familiar with DevOps practices (CI, CD and deployments pipelines). Utilizes tools like Git, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure or Google Cloud for development and deployment.
  • Understanding of front-end technologies (e.g., React, Angular) is a plus.


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • Fully remote position, with the opportunity to travel to the US.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • The chance to work on exciting projects with cutting-edge technologies.

title: Desenvolvedor AEM, Senior
description:
Who Are We.


Newfold Digital is a leading web technology company serving nearly seven million customers globally. Established in 2021 through the combination of leading web services providers Endurance Web Presence and Web.com Group, our portfolio of brands includes: Bluehost, BigRock, ResellerClub, CrazyDomains, HostGator, Network Solutions, Register.com, Web.com and many others.


We help customers of all sizes build a digital presence that delivers results. With our extensive product offerings and personalized support, we take pride in collaborating with our customers to serve their online presence needs.


What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark.

  • Develop and maintain reusable front-end components in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).
  • Work with AEM components and templates, including integrating front-end code with AEM's rendering system.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including designers, back-end developers to deliver digital experiences.


Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed.

  • Advanced English skills .
  • Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and responsive web design principles.
  • Experience integrating Front-end code with AEM components, templates, and workflows.
  • Familiarity with AEM Sightly (HTL) and Sling models and AEM ecosystem.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.


Why you'll love us

  • We offer a 100% remote position with a monthly home office allowance of R$180.00 and an additional allowance for purchasing items for your office.
  • We provide Meal Vouchers or Food Vouchers worth R$44.55 per working day.
  • Health and dental insurance with no co-payment for employees.
  • Well-being program: Gympass, online meditation, and telemedicine!
  • Do you have a dog, cat, rabbit, hamster, goat, turtle, or even a mini dragon? We have a partnership for pet health insurance!
  • Educational platform: you can pursue undergraduate and graduate degrees, language courses (and much more!) at over 100 educational institutions for a very affordable price!
  • Life insurance.
  • Free website hosting.

description:
Who Are We.


Newfold Digital is a leading web technology company serving nearly seven million customers globally. Established in 2021 through the combination of leading web services providers Endurance Web Presence and Web.com Group, our portfolio of brands includes: Bluehost, BigRock, ResellerClub, CrazyDomains, HostGator, Network Solutions, Register.com, Web.com and many others.


We help customers of all sizes build a digital presence that delivers results. With our extensive product offerings and personalized support, we take pride in collaborating with our customers to serve their online presence needs.


What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark.

  • Develop and maintain reusable front-end components in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).
  • Work with AEM components and templates, including integrating front-end code with AEM's rendering system.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including designers, back-end developers to deliver digital experiences.


Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed.

  • Advanced English skills .
  • Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and responsive web design principles.
  • Experience integrating Front-end code with AEM components, templates, and workflows.
  • Familiarity with AEM Sightly (HTL) and Sling models and AEM ecosystem.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.


Why you'll love us

  • We offer a 100% remote position with a monthly home office allowance of R$180.00 and an additional allowance for purchasing items for your office.
  • We provide Meal Vouchers or Food Vouchers worth R$44.55 per working day.
  • Health and dental insurance with no co-payment for employees.
  • Well-being program: Gympass, online meditation, and telemedicine!
  • Do you have a dog, cat, rabbit, hamster, goat, turtle, or even a mini dragon? We have a partnership for pet health insurance!
  • Educational platform: you can pursue undergraduate and graduate degrees, language courses (and much more!) at over 100 educational institutions for a very affordable price!
  • Life insurance.
  • Free website hosting.

title: Desenvolvedor .Net - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, permitindo que eles foquem em seus principais objetivos enquanto cuidamos de suas necessidades de TI. Temos uma excelente oportunidade para você se juntar à nossa equipe na seguinte vaga:

Analista Desenvolvedor .NET – Remoto


O que oferecemos a você:

  • Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;
  • Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;
  • Cartão flex (alimentação e refeição);
  • Auxílio home office para vaga remota;
  • Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Desconto em terapia (plataforma de apoio psicossocial);
  • Parceria com instituições de ensino;
  • Parceria com escolas de idiomas;
  • Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;
  • Programa de indicações com premiação;
  • Licença maternidade de 180 dias e paternidade de 20 dias;
  • Acesso a plataformas de aprendizado como NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy;
  • GetVibes: programa de escuta ativa para evolução contínua do ambiente de trabalho.


O que esperar desta posição:

Atuação em um ambiente corporativo estruturado, com foco em desenvolvimento de soluções robustas e escaláveis.

Modelo de trabalho remoto, em horário comercial.

Contratação CLT.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento .NET/C# e banco de dados;
  • Forte atuação com SQL Server (procedures, functions, triggers, joins);
  • Experiência com .NET Core e/ou .NET Framework;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Programação Orientada a Objetos (OOP);
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de Web APIs e serviços REST;
  • Conhecimento em autenticação e segurança com JSON Web Token (JWT);
  • Experiência com ORM, especialmente Entity Framework;
  • Vivência com testes unitários e práticas como TDD/BDD (xUnit, NUnit, etc.);
  • Experiência com versionamento utilizando Git;
  • Databricks


Diferenciais:

  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Experiência prévia no segmento de saúde.


O que fazer em seguida:

Se você se identifica com essa oportunidade, aguarde nosso contato para avançarmos no processo. Caso tenha dúvidas sobre a vaga ou sobre a Getronics, fique à vontade para entrar em contato com o nosso time de recrutamento.

title: AI Development Orchestrator
description:
Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Reports to: CEO

Stack: TypeScript, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git

Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users

Start: Immediate


The Company

Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.


The Role

You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code.

Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.


What You Do

  • Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\"
  • Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear.
  • Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage.
  • Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent.
  • Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix.
  • Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.


Must-Haves

  • Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author.
  • Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant.
  • TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems.
  • React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns.
  • Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it.
  • Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down.
  • Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations.
  • Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.


Strong Signals

  • Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison.
  • Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code).
  • Database-level access control in production.
  • Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling.
  • OWASP Top 10 fluency.
  • Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.


Red Flags

  • AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you.
  • Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance.
  • Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify.
  • Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review.
  • Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack.
  • Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership.
  • No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.


Who This Person Is

3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant.

You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.


How We Evaluate

No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing.

  • Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom?
  • Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything.
  • Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output?
  • AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.


What We Offer

  • A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access.
  • The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory.
  • Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately.
  • A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only.
  • A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI; quality comes from you.


To Apply or Refer

Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

title: AI Development Orchestrator
description:
Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Reports to: CEO

Stack: TypeScript, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git

Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users

Start: Immediate


The Company

Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.


The Role

You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code.

Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.


What You Do

  • Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\"
  • Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear.
  • Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage.
  • Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent.
  • Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix.
  • Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.


Must-Haves

  • Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author.
  • Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant.
  • TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems.
  • React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns.
  • Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it.
  • Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down.
  • Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations.
  • Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.


Strong Signals

  • Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison.
  • Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code).
  • Database-level access control in production.
  • Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling.
  • OWASP Top 10 fluency.
  • Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.


Red Flags

  • AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you.
  • Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance.
  • Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify.
  • Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review.
  • Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack.
  • Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership.
  • No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.


Who This Person Is

3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant.

You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.


How We Evaluate

No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing.

  • Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom?
  • Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything.
  • Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output?
  • AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.


What We Offer

  • A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access.
  • The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory.
  • Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately.
  • A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only.
  • A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI; quality comes from you.


To Apply or Refer

Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

title: Especialista de Conteúdo
description:
ESPECIALISTA DE CONTEÚDO

  • 100% remoto
  • Remuneração competitiva, alinhada à experiência e ao nível de contribuição
  • Autonomia real para construir, testar e escalar
  • Cultura direta, colaborativa e orientada à responsabilidade, execução e crescimento


SOBRE A ADAFLOW

A Adaflow nasceu para simplificar a vida de quem presta serviços no Brasil ou no exterior.


Ajudamos profissionais e empresas a abrir CNPJ, emitir notas fiscais e cuidar da rotina contábil, sem perder horas com a prefeitura, cartórios, sistemas confusos e burocracias que tiram energia de quem deveria estar focado em crescer.


Combinamos tecnologia, automação e atendimento humano para transformar a contabilidade em uma experiência simples, segura e eficiente.


Conheça mais em:


E agora a gente precisa de alguém que faça com que o conteúdo transmita essa mesma mensagem.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Você vai ser dono(a) do conteúdo da Adaflow. Ponto. Não é executar briefings dos outros, é construir e rodar a estratégia com autonomia real.

Na prática, isso significa:

  • Estratégia e produção de conteúdo orgânico — definir pauta, produzir e distribuir conteúdo para blog, newsletter e redes sociais (LinkedIn, Instagram e o que mais fizer sentido). Cada peça precisa ter uma tese clara, um objetivo definido e uma métrica de sucesso. 
  • Conteúdo SEO-driven que converte intenção em tráfego — produzir conteúdo estratégico para blog e páginas, focado em transformar a intenção de busca em tráfego qualificado. 
  • Pesquisa de palavras-chave e otimização on-page — desenvolver pautas com base em keyword research, estruturar heading tags com hierarquia clara, otimizar meta-tags, title, description e a estrutura de URL.
  • IA como parte do processo — usar ferramentas de IA para escalar pesquisa, primeiras versões, variações e distribuição. Você decide onde a IA entra e sai, mantendo a qualidade editorial no padrão da marca.
  • Régua de comunicação com clientes — desenhar e operar a comunicação recorrente com a base: e-mail marketing, avisos de obrigações fiscais, atualizações de produto, comunicados importantes. Cadência, segmentação e copy são suas responsabilidades.
  • Apoio direto às vendas e ao marketing — produzir LPs, VSLs e fluxos de ativação junto com Growth.
  • Gestão dos próprios projetos — você organiza prazo, escopo e prioridade no Notion/ClickUp, comunica status sem precisar ser cobrada(o) e entrega com contexto.
  • Guardiã(o) do tom de voz e do posicionamento — garantir que tudo o que sai da Adaflow soe como Adaflow, em qualquer canal. Você define guidelines, revisa o que outras áreas publicam quando faz sentido e protege a consistência da marca.
  • Colaboração real com Branding e Growth — o modelo de gestão compartilhada significa que você participa das decisões estratégicas, traz dados e perspectiva editorial. O problema do time é também seu problema.


O QUE A GENTE PROCURA

  • Experiência sólida em conteúdo digital, de ponta a ponta: blog, newsletter e mídias.
  • Curiosidade ativa com IA aplicada à criação de conteúdo: você testa novas ferramentas por conta própria, tem opinião sobre quais usar e pra quê, e está sempre experimentando o que acabou de sair.
  • Repertório de ferramentas é parte do jogo. O stack que essa cadeira costuma rodar passa por: IA e automação de conteúdo (Automarticles, Greatapps, Lovable, Typebot), gestão de projetos (Notion, ClickUp), design (Figma, Canva), SEO (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Surfer), newsletter e e-mail (Substack, Beehiiv, Mailchimp, RD Station), social (Metricool, Buffer) e análise (GA4, Hotjar). Não precisa ter rodado todas, precisa ter repertório e saber escolher a ferramenta certa pro problema certo.
  • Escrita excelente, com repertório para transitar entre formatos e tons sem perder a voz da marca.
  • Capacidade de tocar projeto sozinho(a).
  • Visão analítica: você precisa considerar CAC, engajamento, tráfego orgânico e conversão como parte do seu trabalho.
  • Comunicação direta, pública e clara.


DIFERENCIAIS

  • Automação de marketing e CRM.
  • Vivência em startup ou scale-up de ritmo acelerado, você sabe o que é prazo apertado e prioridade que muda.


NEM TODO MUNDO FOI FEITO PARA ESSE RITMO

Se você quer um lugar onde alguém te diz exatamente o que escrever, precisa de reuniões intermináveis para tomar decisões ou prefere distribuir responsabilidade do que ser dono do resultado, existem boas empresas pra isso. Essa não é uma delas.


Mas se você quer construir a comunicação de uma empresa de tecnologia que está reinventando a contabilidade do Brasil, com automação de ponta, evoluir com gente que coloca a régua pra cima e ter ownership real do que produz, então queremos conhecer você!


Inscreva-se pelo formulário:

ESPECIALISTA DE CONTEÚDO

  • Cultura direta, colaborativa e orientada à responsabilidade, execução e crescimento


SOBRE A ADAFLOW

A Adaflow nasceu para simplificar a vida de quem presta serviços no Brasil ou no exterior.


Ajudamos profissionais e empresas a abrir CNPJ, emitir notas fiscais e cuidar da rotina contábil, sem perder horas com a prefeitura, cartórios, sistemas confusos e burocracias que tiram energia de quem deveria estar focado em crescer.


Combinamos tecnologia, automação e atendimento humano para transformar a contabilidade em uma experiência simples, segura e eficiente.


Conheça mais em:


E agora a gente precisa de alguém que faça com que o conteúdo transmita essa mesma mensagem.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Você vai ser dono(a) do conteúdo da Adaflow. Ponto. Não é executar briefings dos outros, é construir e rodar a estratégia com autonomia real.

Na prática, isso significa:

  • Estratégia e produção de conteúdo orgânico — definir pauta, produzir e distribuir conteúdo para blog, newsletter e redes sociais (LinkedIn, Instagram e o que mais fizer sentido). Cada peça precisa ter uma tese clara, um objetivo definido e uma métrica de sucesso. 
  • Conteúdo SEO-driven que converte intenção em tráfego — produzir conteúdo estratégico para blog e páginas, focado em transformar a intenção de busca em tráfego qualificado. 
  • Pesquisa de palavras-chave e otimização on-page — desenvolver pautas com base em keyword research, estruturar heading tags com hierarquia clara, otimizar meta-tags, title, description e a estrutura de URL.
  • IA como parte do processo — usar ferramentas de IA para escalar pesquisa, primeiras versões, variações e distribuição. Você decide onde a IA entra e sai, mantendo a qualidade editorial no padrão da marca.
  • Régua de comunicação com clientes — desenhar e operar a comunicação recorrente com a base: e-mail marketing, avisos de obrigações fiscais, atualizações de produto, comunicados importantes. Cadência, segmentação e copy são suas responsabilidades.
  • Apoio direto às vendas e ao marketing — produzir LPs, VSLs e fluxos de ativação junto com Growth.
  • Gestão dos próprios projetos — você organiza prazo, escopo e prioridade no Notion/ClickUp, comunica status sem precisar ser cobrada(o) e entrega com contexto.
  • Guardiã(o) do tom de voz e do posicionamento — garantir que tudo o que sai da Adaflow soe como Adaflow, em qualquer canal. Você define guidelines, revisa o que outras áreas publicam quando faz sentido e protege a consistência da marca.
  • Colaboração real com Branding e Growth — o modelo de gestão compartilhada significa que você participa das decisões estratégicas, traz dados e perspectiva editorial. O problema do time é também seu problema.

  • Experiência sólida em conteúdo digital, de ponta a ponta: blog, newsletter e mídias.
  • Curiosidade ativa com IA aplicada à criação de conteúdo: você testa novas ferramentas por conta própria, tem opinião sobre quais usar e pra quê, e está sempre experimentando o que acabou de sair.

title: Engenheiro DevOps (inglês fluente)
description:
Principais Responsabilidades:


• Instalar, configurar, administrar e dar suporte a sistemas e serviços de Core Banking em diferentes ambientes (DEV/UAT/PROD).

• Automatizar atividades operacionais e de deploy utilizando Rundeck e Ansible (orquestração de jobs, playbooks/roles, inventários e gerenciamento seguro de credenciais).

• Criar e manter runbooks, procedimentos operacionais e documentação padrão para permitir execuções repetíveis e auditáveis.

• Fornecer suporte à produção e participar da resposta a incidentes, incluindo triagem, correção e análises pós-incidente (RCA/gestão de problemas).

• Monitorar a saúde e o desempenho dos sistemas; implementar melhorias proativas em disponibilidade, resiliência e capacidade.

• Gerenciar configuração, aplicação de patches e ciclo de vida de componentes de sistema operacional, middleware e aplicações, garantindo conformidade com controles internos.

• Coordenar o controle, renovação e implantação de certificados digitais (ex.: TLS/SSL), incluindo inventário, monitoramento de vencimento, planejamento de mudanças, validação e documentação para evitar interrupções de serviço.

• Trabalhar com equipes de aplicações, infraestrutura e fornecedores para solucionar problemas complexos de ponta a ponta e garantir resolução no prazo.

• Apoiar o gerenciamento de mudanças, planejando, testando, documentando e executando alterações com avaliação de riscos e aprovações adequadas.

• Contribuir para a melhoria de práticas de CI/CD e releases (controle de versão, gestão de artefatos, consistência de ambientes), quando aplicável.

• Aplicar boas práticas de segurança, incluindo hardening, controle de acesso, gestão de segredos e auditabilidade.


Requisitos:

• Mais de 5 anos em Instituições Financeiras; conhecimento do mercado financeiro brasileiro e de produtos/processos de core banking.

• Experiência prática em DevOps/automação com Rundeck e Ansible.

• Conhecimento em scripts (ex.: PowerShell, Bash, Python) para automação e ferramentas operacionais.

• Sólido conhecimento em Windows e Unix/Linux, incluindo troubleshooting, performance e aplicação de patches.

• Experiência com suporte a aplicações e middleware (ex.: servidores web/app, agendamento batch, transferência de arquivos).

• Experiência com ferramentas/tecnologias corporativas como SQL Server, Oracle, Control-M, MQ, ServiceNow, Splunk, Jira, Nexus, LDAP/AD.

• Conhecimento prático em gestão de certificados (inventário, planejamento de renovação/rotação, implantação e validação pós-mudança).

• Entendimento de conceitos de CI/CD e workflows baseados em Git / pipelines de deploy.

• Forte habilidade de comunicação com stakeholders; capacidade de trabalhar com fornecedores globais/locais e equipes internas.

• Inglês avançado.


Desejável:

• Experiência com SAFe; exposição ao GCP.

• Experiência com iniciativas de migração/modernização.

• Espanhol.

title: Atendimento Comercial (Remoto)
description:
New Patient & Lead Conversion Specialist | Appointment Setter | Lead Conversion (Phone + SMS)


Looking for a role where your communication skills directly impact people’s lives and business growth?


We’re hiring a New Patient & Lead Conversion Specialist to own the first interaction with potential patients, convert leads into appointments, and drive results through phone and SMS.

If you have experience with lead conversion, appointment setting, phone sales, and CRM management , this role puts you at the center of growth.


About the Company

We are a fast-growing healthcare and wellness clinic focused on helping patients find real, lasting health solutions. Every first interaction matters, and you’ll play a key role in that experience.


What You’ll Do

  • Handle inbound calls and convert leads into booked appointments
  • Follow up with warm and cold leads (calls + SMS)
  • Manage conversations and pipeline inside CRM (Go HighLevel)
  • Respond quickly and guide leads toward booking
  • Ensure a strong, professional first impression


What Success Looks Like

  • High lead-to-appointment conversion rate
  • Fast response time (calls and SMS)
  • Fully booked schedules
  • Consistent follow-up with all leads
  • Positive patient feedback


Requirements (Must-Have)

  • Fluent English (spoken and written)
  • Experience with lead conversion, appointment setting, or phone sales
  • Strong communication and rapport-building skills
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Self-motivated and performance-driven


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Go HighLevel CRM or similar
  • Background in healthcare, wellness, or service-based businesses


Who You Are

  • Confident on the phone and action-oriented
  • Goal-driven and results-focused
  • Positive, proactive, and accountable
  • Genuinely interested in helping people


Work Model

  • Full-Time (40h/week)
  • Monday to Friday
  • 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM (MST)
  • Remote


Contract Type

  • PJ


Compensation

  • Salary + performance incentives

title: Banco de Talentos GFT -  Desenvolvimento ServiceNow
description:
Banco de Talentos | Desenvolvimento ServiceNow


Estamos construindo um banco de talentos com foco em profissionais de ServiceNow, em diferentes níveis de senioridade (Júnior, Pleno, Sênior e Especialista/Tech Lead), que desejam atuar em projetos desafiadores, com foco em automação de processos, transformação digital e melhoria da experiência do usuário.


Se você busca trabalhar com uma plataforma líder em workflows e gestão de serviços, criando soluções escaláveis e integradas, queremos te conhecer!


O que você poderá fazer por aqui


  • Desenvolver e customizar soluções na plataforma ServiceNow;
  • Criar workflows, automações e aplicações utilizando o ServiceNow;
  • Atuar com desenvolvimento de scripts (server-side e client-side);
  • Trabalhar com criação e customização de módulos, formulários e catálogos de serviços;
  • Integrar o ServiceNow com outros sistemas e APIs;
  • Atuar em diferentes módulos (ITSM, ITOM, HR, CSM, entre outros);
  • Garantir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, governança e performance;
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (negócio, produto, engenharia);
  • Participar de code reviews e melhoria contínua das soluções.


O que buscamos


  • Experiência com desenvolvimento e/ou configuração na plataforma ServiceNow;
  • Conhecimento em JavaScript (base da plataforma);
  • Experiência com criação de workflows, business rules, client scripts e UI policies;

title: Remote SwarmBench Task Engineer - 75063
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are looking for a SwarmBench Task Engineer specializing in planning and operations to design and build complex, multi-agent benchmark tasks that simulate real-world planning, scheduling, and operational decision-making scenarios. This role focuses on creating constraint-rich problems that evaluate multi-agent reasoning, decomposition, and optimization capabilities in realistic environments.


What does day-to-day life look like?

  • Design and develop multi-agent benchmark tasks involving:
  • Planning, scheduling, and resource allocation
  • Operational decision-making (project management, logistics, incident response, capacity planning)
  • Create constraint-rich problem statements with multiple interacting variables
  • Develop verification scripts to evaluate:
  • Feasibility (all constraints satisfied)
  • Completeness (all requirements addressed)
  • Optimality (efficient solutions)
  • Build decomposition strategies:
  • Split tasks across specialized sub-agents (resource-based, constraint-based, conflict resolution, optimization)
  • Model real-world operational scenarios with dependencies, timelines, and resource constraints
  • Collaborate on improving task quality, coverage, and evaluation rigor


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in operations, project management, logistics, or supply chain
  • Strong ability to formalize constraints, dependencies, and scheduling logic
  • Proficiency in Python for building verification and validation scripts
  • Strong structured problem-solving and decomposition skills
  • Clear and precise technical writing skills
  • Experience with AI coding benchmarks (e.g., SWE-bench, Terminal-bench)
  • Hands-on experience with Docker (Dockerfiles, image builds, debugging)


Nice to have:

  • Experience with optimization techniques (linear programming, constraint satisfaction, scheduling algorithms)
  • Background in operations research
  • Experience with simulation or modeling tools
  • Knowledge of AI planning systems or automated reasoning
  • Project management experience or certifications (PMP, Agile, etc.)


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of Contract: 4 weeks (adjustable based on engagement)
  • Location : Bangladesh, Brazil, Colombia, Egypt, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Kenya, Nigeria, Turkey, Vietnam


Evaluation Process:

  • Take home assessment


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Senior Video Editor
description:
Company Description

ONDA Creative Studio is a format development and production studio based in London, producing content for creators and brands across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and beyond. We’re hiring a senior video editor to join the team on a part-time retainer basis.


The Role

You’ll be the lead editor across multiple creator and brand projects. The primary focus is a recurring live dating show format filmed in front of a live audience — approximately 90 minutes, filmed with 4 cameras, edited into a 45-60 minute hero video plus 4-5 short-form cutdowns. Beyond this, you’ll edit long-form YouTube content, short-form brand and creator videos, fitness content, social-first reels, and campaign pieces for clients across a range of industries and platforms.


What You'll Do

  • Edit long-form content (45-60 min) from unscripted, multi-camera live footage. Build narrative, manage pacing, create hooks
  • Cut short-form content for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and LinkedIn — platform-native edits with hooks, captions, and pacing
  • Sync and assemble multicam footage (4 camera angles) from live events
  • Sound design and colour grade to a broadcast-ready standard
  • Edit across a variety of content types: creator, brand partnership, fitness, talking head, social-first, and event content
  • Work within DaVinci Resolve shared project environments where possible, so timelines are accessible to the wider team
  • Use AI tools (specifically Higgsfield) for short-form content workflows where appropriate


What We're Looking For

  • Strong long-form editing skills (15+ min). You understand pacing, retention, hooks, and storytelling from raw unscripted material. Show us your best work
  • Strong short-form editing instinct. You know what makes someone stop scrolling. Platform-native editing for vertical and horizontal formats
  • DaVinci Resolve proficiency is strongly preferred. Shared project experience is a major plus. Not a dealbreaker, but a significant advantage
  • Multicam editing experience is a bonus, ideally from live events, reality TV, or unscripted formats
  • Competent sound design and colour grading. Your grades should be clean and your audio broadcast-ready
  • Self-directed. You can take a rough brief and deliver a polished first cut without needing frame-by-frame instructions
  • Reliable. You deliver when you say you will. If something changes, you communicate before the deadline, not after
  • Open to AI-assisted workflows. Specifically Higgsfield for short-form content. You don’t need to be an expert, but you need to be curious
  • Politically impartial and professional. ONDA works with clients across a range of industries, causes, and viewpoints. This role requires a professional, unbiased approach to all content — the work is the work, regardless of subject matter


Details

HOURS: Part-time (roughly 30 hours per week)

RATE: Competitive monthly retainer, based on experience and portfolio strength

LOCATION: Fully remote. Any timezone. Deadlines are the measure, not hours

SOFTWARE: DaVinci Resolve strongly preferred

DURATION: Ongoing, with a 4-week paid trial period

START: May 2026

title: Cientista de dados
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver soluções baseadas em LLMs, incluindo RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).
  • Projetar e implementar pipelines de indexação, recuperação e ranking de informação.
  • Criar e otimizar prompts visando qualidade, consistência e segurança das respostas.
  • Construir APIs de IA utilizando FastAPI.
  • Integrar modelos de linguagem a sistemas existentes.
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados e inferência.
  • Avaliar e monitorar desempenho de sistemas de IA em produção.
  • Trabalhar em ambiente ágil seguindo práticas de SCRUM.

Requisitos:

  • Python + ML/DL (PyTorch)
  • SQL + modelagem de dados
  • Estatística
  • LLMs + RAG + embeddings
  • APIs de IA (OpenAI, etc.)
  • Docker + Git
  • Cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure)
  • MLOps / LLMOps

Diferenciais:

  • Vector DBs (Pinecone, Weaviate, PGVector)
  • LangChain / LlamaIndex
  • Sistemas de recomendação modernos
  • Avaliação de LLMs

  • Desenvolver e expandir o mercado de soluções analíticas em nível nacional
  • Prospectar novos clientes e identificar oportunidades de negócio
  • Gerenciar contas estratégicas e fortalecer relacionamentos
  • Apresentar e vender soluções técnicas com abordagem consultiva
  • Apoiar representantes comerciais e atuar em conjunto com áreas internas
  • Elaborar propostas, negociar e conduzir o fechamento de vendas
  • Acompanhar o funil de vendas e manter o CRM atualizado


O que buscamos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia (Química, Mecânica, Elétrica ou áreas correlatas)
  • Experiência com vendas técnicas no segmento industrial
  • Conhecimento em processos industriais e/ou instrumentação
  • Vivência com CRM e gestão de pipeline
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes em todo o Brasil
  • CNH válida
  • Inglês intermediário


⭐ Será um diferencial:

  • Experiência com instrumentação analítica ou automação industrial
  • Vivência com vendas consultivas e projetos técnicos
  • Conhecimento em analisadores de processo (gases, líquidos, etc.)
  • Relacionamento com clientes industriais (química, energia, papel e celulose, óleo & gás, entre outros)


O que oferecemos:

  • Salário compatível com o mercado
  • Prêmio anual por desempenho

title: BackOffice
description:
Descrição do Cargo: Auxiliar nas demandas do departamento comercial, Cadastrar clientes no sistema, Cadastrar propostas comerciais no sistema, Consultar CDL (SPC e Serasa) após a proposta ser aprovada, antes da emissão do contrato, Emitir novos contratos após aprovação de propostas, Acompanhamento de assinatura eletrônica de contratos e aditivos, Emitir aditivos a maior, a menor, de renovação, Atualizar parcelas de contratos e aditivos após a entrega, e realizar ajustes quando necessário, com orientação do consultor comercial, Solicitar cotação de equipamento aos fornecedores quando necessário, Repassar informações do fechamento do contrato ao setor operacional para realização do serviço, Encerrar contratos no sistema, Solicitar ao setor operacional a retirada de equipamento em caso de encerramento de contrato ou aditivo menor, Solicitar ao setor operacional a entrega de equipamento ou realização de serviços, Arquivar contratos assinados, Fazer requisições de equipamentos para o estoque, Enviar pedidos ou contratos ao financeiro para faturamento, Arquivar documentos do departamento comercial, Solicitar cotação de logística de viagem para envio de propostas, Comparecer às reuniões e organizar atas relacionadas a pendências de tratativas comerciais, Fazer boletim de medição, Realizar pós-venda com o cliente após a realização do serviço.


  • Operações de BackOffice: Experiência em rotinas administrativas e organização de processos internos para suporte operacional.
  • Comunicação e Atendimento ao Cliente: Habilidades claras de comunicação escrita e verbal, além de experiência no atendimento ao cliente para lidar com demandas de forma profissional e eficiente.
  • Finanças e Vendas: Conhecimento em rotinas financeiras e no suporte a equipes de vendas.
  • Desejável formação em Administração, Contabilidade ou áreas relacionadas, além de habilidades em ferramentas como Excel e sistemas CRM.

title: Assistente de Vendas (Inglês Fluente)
description:
International Sales Assistant | Remote & Fluent English – C1


At Bluedot BPO Solutions, we connect top LATAM talent with high-performing U.S. sales teams. We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Sales Assistant with strong English skills to support sales operations and outbound prospecting.


This is a fully remote role with daily exposure to the U.S. market and a clear path toward an international sales career.


What We Offer


  • Monthly compensation of R$4,000
  • 100% remote, supporting U.S. sales teams
  • Monday to Friday, 12 PM – 21 PM (BRT)
  • Real long-term position
  • Possibility of growth opportunities (SDR, Account Executive, Leadership)
  • International exposure and multicultural environment
  • Structured training and continuous coaching


Your Responsibilities


  • Support outbound prospecting campaigns for U.S. clients
  • Execute prospecting activities (calls, emails, messages, follow-ups)
  • Qualify B2B leads and maintain an updated pipeline
  • Participate in sales meetings and prepare support materials
  • Log activities and metrics in CRM systems (HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, etc.)
  • Assist with administrative sales routines
  • Follow defined processes and KPIs consistently


What We’re Looking For


  • Advanced English (C1) — strong verbal and written communication
  • Highly organized and able to multitask
  • Resilient, proactive, and goal-oriented profile
  • Comfortable in fast-paced environments
  • Availability to work the proposed shift


Nice to Have


  • Experience in outbound prospecting, B2B/B2C sales, or SDR roles
  • Familiarity with CRMs and sales automation tools
  • Fast learner and tech-savvy mindset
  • KPI-driven profile


Technical Requirements


  • Laptop with i5/i7 (or equivalent) and 12GB+ RAM
  • High-speed internet
  • Professional headset
  • Quiet home office environment


Build your international sales career.


Work directly with U.S. teams and grow in a high-performance environment.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back End .Net PL
description:
Venha fazer parte de um time inovador como como Pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend .NET Pl, dentro de um ambiente que valoriza espírito empreendedor, autonomia, agilidade, foco no cliente, excelência e visão de longo prazo e inconformismo, num projeto de PIX, garantindo a segurança e eficiência das operações financeiras.

Vaga inicialmente temporária de 4 meses, com grandes chances de efetivação.


Necessário:

  • Experiência com .NET / .NET Core (C#)
  • Experiência com banco de dados relacionais e não relacionais
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful
  • Experiência com Design Patterns
  • Experiência com testes unitários (TDD)
  • Experiência em GIT
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum)
  • Experiência em mensagerias (RabbitMQ/SNS/SQS)
  • Experiência e Conhecimento em ambiente e serviços cloud (AWS).
  • Compromisso com qualidade de código.


Desejável:

  • Experiência com ferramentas de Code Quality (sonar) e monitoramento com Datadog.
  • Capacidade de escrever código robusto, testável e validado.


Soft skills:

  • Boa comunicação
  • Perfil colaborativo
  • Senso de dono
  • Comprometimento e responsabilidade com prazos e horários
  • Proatividade


Formação: Curso Superior Completo ou cursando em TI


Onde? Remoto


Horário : 09:00 às 18:00 ou 10:00 às 19:00 Segunda a Sexta-feira.


Benefícios e Incentivos

Saúde e Bem-estar: Assistências Médica e Odontológica (SulAmérica), Seguro de Vida (Prudential), Previdência Privada (Onze) e acesso ao WellHub para cuidar da mente e do corpo, além de VR Caju.

Desenvolvimento: Coparticipação na assinatura do Alura, ajuda para cursos de inglês, Ciclo de Avaliação de Desempenho com Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI), e programas internos de mentoria e capacitação profissional.

Equilíbrio: Com nosso benefício de Antecipação de Férias, quem tem entre 6 e 12 meses de contrato pode aproveitar o descanso sem perder esse direito ao mudar de emprego.

Diversidade e Inclusão: Todas as nossas oportunidades são elegíveis para pessoas com deficiência.

Sobre a Elumini

Somos uma consultoria sólida no mercado de TI, com operações na América do Sul, América do Norte e Europa. Certificada pelo Great Place to Work®, somos reconhecidos por nossa forma única de valorizar profissionais e promover um ambiente diferenciado.

Candidate-se e decole sua carreira! Venha ser um(a) Eluminer!

title: Engenheiro(a) de dados Sênior- Azure Fabric
description:
• Projetar arquiteturas de dados escaláveis em cloud (Azure Fabric, Databricks)
  • ● Desenhar pipelines de ingestão em tempo real e batch (Kafka, Event Hubs, Service
  • Bus)
  • ● Modelar Data Lakehouses com Delta Lake e otimizar particionamento
  • ● Definir estratégias de governança e segurança (Purview, RBAC, data lineage)
  • ● Migração e Modernização
  • ● Converter sistemas legados para plataformas modernas
  • ● Traduzir lógica complexa de stored procedures para PySpark/SQL
  • ● Validar integridade de dados pós-migração e corrigir discrepâncias
  • ● Implementar processos de delta load e CDC (Change Data Capture)
  • ● Performance e Qualidade
  • ● Otimizar queries e processamentos para grande volume de dados
  • ● Estabelecer deduplicação e validação de schemas
  • ● Implementar monitoramento e observabilidade (Application Insights)
  • ● Documentação e Colaboração
  • ● Documentar arquiteturas com diagramas técnicos
  • ● Criar mapeamentos DE-PARA entre sistemas legados e novos
  • ● Trabalhar com stakeholders de negócio e times de BI/analytics

REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS

● PySpark / Apache Spark (transformações complexas, window functions, joins)

● SQL avançado (CTEs, window functions, otimização)

● Microsoft Fabric e Databricks (Lakehouse, Delta Lake)

● Azure (Event Hubs, Storage, Data Factory, Key Vault)

● Modelagem dimensional e normalização

● Git e CI/CD

REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS DESEJÁVEIS

● Kafka e streaming em tempo reale NRT

● Power BI (Direct Lake, DAX)

● Oracle Siebel ou CRMs enterprise

● Python para automação

● Schemas JSON/Parquet

● Microsoft Purview

OUTROS DIFERENCIAIS

● Experiência com migração de sistemas legados

● Redução de custos operacionais e FinOps

● Certificações Azure (DP-203, AZ-305)
